Statement: Sensor must measure phase current up to plus/minus 400 A
Rationale: Close the torque control loop on peak phase current

Statement: Sensor must be accurate enough to detect uncontrolled torque
Rationale: Detect fault before torque exceeds 20 Nm

Statement: Sensor must be fast enough for the inverter control loop
Sensor must isolate HV from LV side
Sensor must detect its own failures and report them
Rationale: ASIL C needs a safety mechanism

Statement: Sensor must reach the required diagnostic coverage
Rationale: Meet SPFM target for ASIL C

Statement: Sensor runs from the control-unit 5 V rail
Sensor must work across the powertrain temperature range
